summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AllianzIM U.S. Equity Buffer15 Uncapped Jan ETF (JANU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in enhanced growth alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and uncapped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust over a one-year period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. JANU was launched on Dec 31, 2024 and is issued by Allianz.

completeness: holdings are every published row for this fund in the issuer's own dated portfolio table, and all of them share one Date

rows are normalized with the Innovator row contract because the issuer publishes the same columns: signed Weightings, CUSIP identity, option legs kept with a composite provider ticker so symbol stays null
NetAssets is the fund's total net assets (AUM) and SharesOutstanding is the fund's share count; the row Price is the instrument's own price and is never used as the ETF price or a per-share NAV
weights stay exactly as published and signed, with no sum-to-100 check
the page carries no dated history and no fund classification
